Comment: Impact of Phase III BREAKTHROUGH activities.
Response: As noted in the text, Environmental Statements will be filed for Phase III projects through regular HUD program channels. There are no appropriate mechanisms to control free market activities of the producers in resource utilization other than those available for the general economy.
E. Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
Comment: Need for training and maintenance information.
Response: Most BREAKTHROUGH prototype housing will be occupied by individuals who have lived in adequate housing, but provisions are being made for those sites being marketed under subsidy programs for community association groups to provide training. Also, each of the housing units is supplied with a maintenance manual, prepared by the producer and approved by HUD, which provides specific instruction for the equipment, appliances and finishes for that unit.
Comment: Renovation of substandard units.
Response: BREAKTHROUGH was specifically directed at the production of new housing. HUD also has in progress a Project Rehab under the direction of the Assistant Commissioner for Rehabilitation, Federal Housing Administration, which directly addresses the renovation problem.
F. Department of Transportation
Comment: Recognition of mutual objectives; accepts statement.
Response: Acceptance of statement appreciated. Several cooperative activities with Department of Transportation are continuing.
G. Department of Commerce
Comment: Requested extension of time. No comments have subsequently been received.
Response: None.
H. Federal Power Commission
<u>Comment</u>: Total energy systems are not unique; some design problems.
Response: See final statement for discussion of total energy system application on Jersey City site and program for data recording there.
